messages:
rachel: Quick micro-onboard for glaciator-9b variants. Need a short routing + unit-econ rec for product.

hao: paste the key numbers pls.

rachel: Topline (fp16 13b baseline for ref):
- glaciator-9b-int5-mix: p50=75ms p95=170ms synth-qa delta=-0.45pp, throughput~1080 tok/s, est $0.57/1M
- glaciator-9b-int6: p50=80ms p95=185ms synth-qa delta=-0.6pp, throughput~980 tok/s, est $0.76/1M
- glaciator-9b-int4: p50=68ms p95=225ms synth-qa delta=-3.2pp, throughput~1240 tok/s, est $0.43/1M
- core-13b-int8 (safety): p50=140ms p95=355ms synth-qa delta=-0.25pp, throughput~660 tok/s, est $1.11/1M

diego: int5-mix looks attractive. any KL/JS numbers vs fp16?

rachel: JS-divergence (top-token): int5-mix=0.010, int4=0.041. logit-gap median change small for int5-mix.

sophia: how does int4 behave on long-context & warmstart?

rachel: int4 shows KV cold-start spikes on >600 token history; int5-mix keeps KV layers higher-precision so p95 stable. also saw a handful of long-summary hallucinations on int4 (~1.8% of summarization slice).

hao: routing suggestion? product needs exact phrasing and config snippet.

rachel: proposal: 70% -> glaciator-9b-int5-mix (default), 20% -> glaciator-9b-int4 for ultra-short chats (query_tokens<=60 and history_tokens<=120), 10% -> core-13b-int8 fallback. Hijack rules: entropy>3.25 OR top_logit_diff < 0.85 -> route to 13b. Add low-rate warm probes for cheap-short bucket (1 probe per 8k active users) to keep KV hot.

diego: blended cost?

rachel: blended ~= 0.7*0.57 + 0.2*0.43 + 0.1*1.11 = $0.64 / 1M tokens. expected p95 <230ms for ~90% traffic with these rules.

hao: product phrasing?

rachel: "Expected QA delta ~0.4-0.8pp vs fp16-13b under proposed routing. High-risk or low-confidence queries are routed to a higher-fidelity fallback. Monitoring and rollback guardrails in place."

ops-bot: deploy-canary: route config applied to canary c-202510-02, 1% traffic, start=2025-10-02T08:00:00Z :rocket:

sophia: monitor per-route synth-qa delta, hijack rate, p95, and warm-probe effectiveness. rollback cheap-short if synth-qa drift >1.2pp for 30m.

rachel: will push dashboard + 6h runbook and report canary snapshot here. :bar_chart:
